m: प्रति-√ राध् (only ind.p. -राध्य), to counteract, oppose (acc.), Gaut. : Desid. -रित्सति, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 54, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
प्रति-˚राध m. ‘obstacle, hindrance’, N. of partic. verses of the AV.; AitBr.; Vait. (cf. प्रती-र्˚, p. 673).
प्रति-˚राद्ध mfn. counteracted, Gaut.
प्रति-√ राज् Ā. -राजते, to shine like (इव), equal in splendour, Hariv.
प्रति—राज (Kull.) or प्रति—रा˚जन् (R.), m. a hostile king, royal adversary.
प्रति—राजम् ind. king by king, for every k˚, Pat.
प्रति—रात्रम् (Hit.) or प्रति—रा˚त्रि (Vcar.), ind. each night, nightly.
प्रति—रौद्र-कर्मन् mfn. acting cruelly against others, R.
प्रति-˚रूढ mfn. imitated, BhP.
प्रति—रूपा f. N. of a daughter of Meru, BhP.

s: klI, (pratigataM pratikftaM vA rUpamiti prAdisamAsaH .) pratimA । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 10 । 21 । “BavAn me Kal BaktAnAM sarvvezAM pratirUpaDfk ॥” tri, pratigataM rUpamasya । anurUpaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 102 । 61 । “AtmanaH pratirUpo'sO labDaH patiriti sTite । bicitravIryyaM kalyARyO pUjayAmAsatuH SuBe ॥” dAnavaviSeze, puM । yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 227 । 51 । “viSvajit pratirUpaSca vfzARqo vizkaro maDuH ॥”)
v: na॰ pratikftaM rUpam prA॰ sa॰ । 1 tulyarUpe pratimAyAm trikA॰ । 2 dAnavaBede pu॰ BA॰ SA॰ 287 a॰ । 3 merusAvarRerduhitfBede strI BAga॰ 5 । 2 । 23 pratikftaM rUpaM yena prA॰ va॰ । 4 tulyarUpayute tri॰ “rUpaM rUpaM pratirUpo baBUva” SrutiH
m: प्रति—रूप n. the counterpart of any real form, an image, likeness, representation, MBh.; Var.; BhP. (also f(आ). , KauṣUp.)
a pattern, model for imitation (cf. -धृक् below)
anything falsified, a counterfeit of (gen.), Viṣṇ.
प्रति—रूप mf(आ)n. like, similar, corresponding, suitable, proper, fit, RV. &c. &c. (˚पम् अकुर्वन्, not requiting, MārkP.)
agreeable, beautiful, MBh.
प्रति—रूप m. N. of a Dānava, ib.
प्रति—रूप—धृक् mfn. offering (i.e. being) a model or pattern, BhP.
प्रति—रूप—चर्या f. suitable or exemplary conduct, ŚBr.
प्रति—रूप—चर्य mfn. exemplary in conduct, worthy of imitation, MW.

s: klI, (pratirUpa + svArTe kan .) prativimbam । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 59 । 49 । “agnidErgaradEScEva pratirUpakakArakEH । SreRImuKyopajApena vIruDaSCedanena ca ॥”)
v: na॰ pratikftaM rUpaM vimbasya yena prA॰ ba॰ kap । pratibimbe jawA॰ ।
m: प्रति—रूपक n. an image, a picture, L.
forgery, Nār.
(prob.) a forged edict, MBh.
प्रति—रूपक mf(इका)n. similar, corresponding, having the appearance of anything (generally ifc.), MBh.; Mn.; Śak. &c.
प्रति—रूपक m. a quack, charlatan, Car.
प्रति—रूप—ता f. resemblance, Harav.
प्रति—रूप्य in अ-प्˚ w.r. for अ-प्रातिरूप्य See प्रातिर्˚.
प्र-तिर , ˚रम्. See under प्र-√ तॄ.
1. प्र-˚तिर mfn. furthering, granting success or victory, AitĀr.
2. प्र-˚तिर mfn. (?) carrying across, furthering, helping, TS. (Sch.)

v: pu॰ pratikUlo raTo yasya prA॰ ba॰ । 1 pratiyoDe anADfzyavaMSye taMsuBrAtari nfpaBede harivaM॰ 32 a॰ । yaduvaMSye 3 vajrASvaputre harivaM॰ 162 a॰ । avyayI॰ । 3 pratye karaTe avya॰ ।
m: प्रति—रथ m. an opposite fighter in a war-chariot, an adversary in war, equal a˚, Kathās. (cf. अ-प्˚)
N. of a descendant of Atri (author of the hymn, RV. v, 47), RAnukr.
of a son of Mati-nāra and father of Kaṇva, Hariv.
of a son of Vajra and father of Sucāru, ib.
प्रति—रथ्यम् ind. in every road, Kāv.
प्रति-रञ्जित mfn. (√ रञ्ज्) coloured, reddened, MBh.; R.
प्रति—रजनि ind. every night, Naiṣ.
प्रति-√ रक्ष् P. -रक्षति, to preserve, guard, protect, AV.; MBh.; to keep (a promise), MBh.; to be afraid of, fear (acc.), VS.
प्रति-˚रक्षा f. safety, preservation
प्रति-˚रक्˚षार्थम् ind. for the sake of saving, MW.
प्रति-˚रक्षण n. preserving, protecting, W.
प्रति-√ रम् P. -रमति, to look towards with joy, long for, expect (acc.), Kāraṇḍ.

s: puM, (prati + lamBa + BAve GaY । lasya raH .) pratilamBaH । iti dvirUpakozaH ॥
v: pu॰ pratilamBa + lasya raH । pratilamBe dvirUzakozaH ।
m: प्रति-रम्भ m. (√ रभ्) = प्रतिलम्भ, L.
passion, rage, violent or passionate abuse, W.
प्रति-√ रप् P. -रपति, to whisper to, tell something (acc.) in a whisper to (dat.), RV.
प्रति-√ रस् P. -रसति, to echo, resound, Caṇḍ.
प्रति-˚रसित n. echo, resonance, Veṇīs.
प्रति-˚रत mfn. delighting in, zealous for (loc.), R.

v: pu॰ pratiruvanti prati + ru--karttari ac । 1 prARezu yaju॰ 38 । 15 “prARA vE pratiravAH” Sata॰ brA॰ 14 । 2 । 2 । 34 BAve ap pratikUlI ravaH prA॰ sa॰ । 2 pratikUlaSabde madIyaM DanaM na moktavyamanena madIyaM DanaM balAdBujyate ityAdi lokezu udDvozaRaM pratiravaH ।
m: प्रति-˚रव m. crying or calling out to, quarrelling, Pañcat.
(also pl.) echo, ib.; Kathās.; Rājat.
(prob.) = उप-रव, VS.; ŚBr.
a: प्रतिरवः — 1 Quarrel, contest. --2 Echo. --3 Ved. Life (प्राण).

m: प्रति-√ रिह् P. -रिहति, to lick, AV.
प्रति—रिपु ind. against the enemy or the enemies, Śiś.

s: [n] puM, (pratiruRadDIti । prati + ruD + RiniH । pratiroDastiraskAro'styasyeti vA । pratiroDa + iniH .) cOraH । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 25 ॥

v: pu॰ prati + ruDa--BAve GaY । 1 niroDe । svArTe ka । 2 pratibanDe 3 tiraskAre BarataH । karttari ac । 4 prakfta sADyAnumitiniroDake satpakzadozaduzwe hetO “pakzasADyasADanAprasidDisvarUpAsidDibADapratiroDAnAM nirAsaH” dIDiti॰ । BAve GaY । 5 haWacOryye ।
m: प्रति-˚रोध m. opposition, impediment, obstruction (-कर mfn. obstructing, Suśr.)
= तिरस्कार, व्युत्थान, चौर्य, L.
a: प्रतिरोधः — 1 Impediment, obstruction, hindrance. --2 Siege, blockade. --3 An opponent. --4 Concealing. --5 Theft, robbery. --6 Censure, despising.

s: puM, (pratiruRadDi pratiruDya cOryyaM karotIti । prati + ruD + Rvul .) coraH । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 45 ॥
v: pu॰ prati + ruDa--Rvul । 1 pratibanDake (qAkAyita) 2 haWacOre hemaca॰ । tasya roDanena steyakartftvAt taTAtvam ।
m: प्रति-˚रोधक m. an opposer, preventer, Kād.
a robber, thief, Mālav.
an obstacle, W.
a: प्रतिरोधक, प्रतिरोधिन्-द्धृ — a. 1 Obstructing. --2 Besieging. --m. 1 An opponent. --2 A robber, thief; M. 5. 10. --3 An obstacle.

m: प्रति-˚रोध—कर mfn., obstructing, Suśr.
प्रति-˚रोधन n. obstruction, prevention, MBh.
allowing anything (gen.) to pass by fruitlessly, Mn. ix, 93.

v: tri॰ prati + ruDa--Rini । 1 pratibanDake 2 pratiruDya haWahAriRi cOre amaraH ।
m: प्रति-˚रोधिन् mfn. obstructing, hindering &c.
प्रति-˚रोधिन् m. a robber, thief, Mālatīm.

k.v: प्रतिरोधिपरास्कन्दिपाटच्चरमलिम्लुचाः। चौरिका स्तैन्यचोर्ये च स्तेयं लोप्त्रं तु तद्धने॥

m: प्रति-˚रोद्धृ m. an opposer (with gen.), Mn.; MBh.
प्रति-˚रोपित mfn. (fr. Caus.) planted again, Ragh.
प्रति-रोषितव्य n. impers. (√ रुष्) anger is to be returned, L.
प्रति-√ रु P. -रौति, to cry or call to (acc.), Var.
प्रति-√ रुध् P. Ā. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, or -रुन्धति, ˚ते, to check, hinder, prevent, oppose, resist, TS.; Br. &c.; to confine, keep back, shut off, MBh.; BhP.; to cover, conceal, MBh.; Hariv.
a: प्रतिरुध् — {c7c} U. 1 To obstruct, stop; oppose, resist. --2 To blockade, besiege. --3 To impair disable. --4 To blame, accuse. --5 To hide, conceal.

m: प्रति-रुंषित mfn. covered with dust, Anarghar.
प्रति-√ रुच् Ā. -रोचते, to please (with acc.), RV. : Caus. -रोचयति, to be pleased to (acc.), resolve, decide upon, MBh.
प्रति-˚रुद्ध mfn. checked, prevented, stopped, disturbed, interrupted, Mn.; MBh. &c.
shut off, kept away, withdrawn, MBh.; BhP.
rendered imperfect, impaired, MW.
a: प्रतिरुद्ध — p. p. 1 Impeded, obstructed, hindered. --2 Interrupted. --3 Impaired. --4 Disabled. --5 Invested, blockaded.

m: प्रति-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to sprout or grow again, MBh. : Caus. -रोपयति, to plant anything in its proper place, Var.; to plant again (lit. and fig.), re-establish, Ragh.
प्रति-˚रुरूषु mfn. wishing to speak or tell, W.
प्रति-˚रुत mfn. answered by crying or calling, Var.
